type: MVEI kernel certificate for a branch

history_not_on_default_branch.subject: Add HSCS quick start guide - implementation complete
Complete HSCS implementation with full pipeline demonstration
Add engineering component analyzer and comprehensive documentation
Add HSCS formalization and transpilation system

verification.checker: Lean 4 kernel; axioms read with Lean.collectAxioms (#print axioms)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: compilation_preserves_scope
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : Sentence) : compile_standard s → ∃ x, InScope x (scopeForLine s.line_number)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: complete_page_ledger_valid
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (sentences : List Sentence) : (∀ s ∈ sentences, s.line_number ≥ 1001 ∧ s.line_number ≤ 1030) → PageLedger sentences

theorems_only_on_branches.name: hscs_is_certification_system
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ∀ (s : Sentence), (s.core.token_type = TokenType.CORE) ∧ (s.seal.token_type = TokenType.SEAL) → ∃ (x : Entity), InScope x (scopeForLine s.line_number)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: scope_context_free
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (line : Nat) (s1 s2 : Sentence) : s1.line_number = line → s2.line_number = line → scopeForLine s1.line_number = scopeForLine s2.line_number

theorems_only_on_branches.name: scope_deterministic
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (line1 line2 : Nat) : line1 = line2 → scopeForLine line1 = scopeForLine line2

theorems_only_on_branches.name: valid_sentence_has_typed_tokens
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (s : Sentence) : s.core.token_type = TokenType.CORE ∧ s.seal.token_type = TokenType.SEAL ∧ (∀ t ∈ s.metadata, t.token_type = TokenType.MOD)
